claim: Exports claim trails as Markdown and CSV for free.
sandbox: open /?demo=1 from a fresh browser context; download both exports and assert the shipped sample content is present

claim: Demo sample data is separate from your real workspace and can be discarded.
where: demo banner, landing action note, README
sandbox: seed a real trail, open /?demo=1, assert only demo records render, then Start for real and assert demo storage is gone

claim: The demo opens exactly two sample trails and leaves the real workspace unchanged.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1#workspace, assert two visible sample cards and no real workspace trail key

claim: No claim trail is stored until you save it.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; assert no trail key before save, save one trail, then assert its text exists in the trail key

claim: Your claim and source content stays in this browser.
sandbox: edit a sample trail in /?demo=1 while recording requests; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Create and export a claim trail without an account.
sandbox: open / from a fresh browser context; create, complete, and export a trail without any sign-in or account step

claim: Create, revise, search, filter, and reversibly delete claim trails, including counterevidence and readiness status.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; create complete counterevidence, edit it, search and filter it, delete it, undo, and assert status throughout

claim: The sample workspace works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context; open /?demo=1, wait for the service worker, set offline, reload, and assert the sample trail and offline notice render

claim: Markdown and CSV exports keep working offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context; cache /?demo=1, go offline, reload, download both formats, and assert sample content in each file

claim: The $18 Instructor kit opens Sociobot/Dodo checkout.
sandbox: open the home page and assert the advertised checkout endpoint responds with a 303 redirect to checkout.dodopayments.com without following it

claim: If Sociobot verification changes a valid license to inactive, the Instructor kit locks.
sandbox: mock a valid Sociobot verdict followed by an inactive verdict; assert the cached kit state changes from unlocked to locked

claim: The site identifies its original generated hero art and links to its details.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the footer disclosure, shipped hero asset, and Artwork terms section

claim: No student work is sent to an AI model.
where: privacy promise removed from landing; verified product behavior
sandbox: record every request while editing and saving a demo trail; assert only same-origin requests and no AI endpoint

claim: An active Instructor kit adds course labels to Markdown and offers 7/30/90-day local deletion choices.
sandbox: seed a current cached license verdict plus old/recent local trails; assert automatic deletion, every retention choice, and a labeled Markdown export

claim: An active Instructor kit previews and imports student CSV exports locally, labels each submission, skips duplicates, shows totals, and supports undo.
sandbox: fresh browser with cached valid license; upload two CSV files with one duplicate, inspect preview, import, assert labels and totals, then undo

claim: When the daily count is due, a visit sends one bodyless request; the backend receives no claim content and stores only a date and count.
sandbox: record requests while creating a private trail; assert the sole POST is same-origin and bodyless, then assert the SQLite page_views table has only day and count columns

claim: Delete all local data removes trails, settings, page-count state, and the Instructor kit credential.
sandbox: seed every product-owned storage namespace, use the in-product deletion control, and assert no product-owned key remains

claim: A license token is sent only to the Sociobot product endpoint and a valid verdict is reused for at most one day.
sandbox: mock the Sociobot response, assert the exact product-scoped URL, then verify a second check uses the cached daily verdict without another request

claim: The anonymous page count is sent at most once per browser day.
sandbox: fresh browser; reload twice on one stored date and assert one POST, then set the marker to an earlier date and assert one new POST

claim: The page-count route limits each first X-Forwarded-For client separately and returns 429 with Retry-After after a 40-request burst.
sandbox: in-memory SQLite router; send 41 requests for one forwarded IP and one request for a second IP; assert 429, Retry-After, and client separation

claim: The release container uses a non-root app user and serves the app and health route on port 8080.
sandbox: inspect the release Docker stage and server router for USER app, EXPOSE 8080, entrypoint, root route, and health route; deployed identity is checked in handoff

claim: The product loads no payment-provider script or frame before checkout is opened.
sandbox: fresh browser; record home requests and frames before purchase; assert one top frame and no payment-provider origin

claim: Creating, viewing, searching, and exporting a trail does not fetch publisher pages; exports contain only stored source details and excerpts.
sandbox: demo workspace; record requests through search and CSV export, assert no publisher host request, a source link remains available, and stored excerpt is exported

claim: The app records what the student enters and does not generate essays or score a claim as true.
sandbox: fresh browser; assert fields start blank, no generation or truth-scoring action exists, and saved output matches the student's input
